mapper.select: SELECT simulation.layout_version_id FROM simulations simulation JOIN simulation_results result ON result.simulation_id = simulation.id WHERE simulation.id = #{simulationId} AND simulation.status = 'COMPLETED'

SELECT bottleneck.start_time_seconds, bottleneck.end_time_seconds, bottleneck.peak_density, bottleneck.threshold_value, bottleneck.geometry FROM detected_bottlenecks bottleneck JOIN simulation_results result ON result.id = bottleneck.simulation_result_id WHERE result.simulation_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY bottleneck.bottleneck_order ASC

SELECT heatmap.chunk_sequence, heatmap.density_data FROM heatmaps heatmap JOIN simulation_results result ON result.id = heatmap.simulation_result_id WHERE result.simulation_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY heatmap.chunk_sequence ASC

SELECT timeline.chunk_sequence, timeline.frame_data FROM timelines timeline JOIN simulation_results result ON result.id = timeline.simulation_result_id WHERE result.simulation_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY timeline.chunk_sequence ASC

SELECT metric.metric_type, metric.unit, metric.metric_value FROM simulation_metrics metric JOIN simulation_results result ON result.id = metric.simulation_result_id WHERE result.simulation_id = #{simulationId}
